source: Statistics Canada; Department of Finance Canada
source_table: Statistics Canada 10-10-0048-01 (fiscal years 1867–2008); Finance Canada, Fiscal Reference Tables 2025 (Tables 15 and 2); GDP: Statistics Canada 36-10-0104-01 (1961–) and Historical Statistics of Canada 11-516-X series F13 (1926–1960)
frequency: annual (fiscal years ending March 31; June 30 before 1907)
transformations: fy_end = the calendar year in which the fiscal year ends

gdp = the calendar year in which the fiscal year begins (Finance Canada's convention); 36-10-0104-01 calendar-year mean of the quarterly annual rates from 1961, Historical Statistics GNP at market prices for 1926–1960 linked to it at 1961 (factor 1.060)
the two debt series are kept separate (public accounts rules changed at 1983-84); they overlap 1983-84 to 2007-08
